author: CoolVision
description:
In this travel documentary we explore Japan’s northern frontier — from the city of Sapporo to the island’s volcanic landscapes and legendary powder snow.

We begin in Sapporo, visiting Odori Park, the Sapporo TV Tower, Sapporo Clock Tower, the Red Brick Government Building, Hokkaido University, and the nightlife district of Susukino. Along the way we experience the Sapporo Snow Festival, ride the Mount Moiwa Ropeway, and try local food at Nijo Market, Ramen Alley, the Sapporo Beer Museum, and Shiroi Koibito Park.

Next we head to the historic port city of Otaru, known for the Otaru Canal, Sakaimachi Street, the Otaru Music Box Museum, and views from Mount Tengu.

Then it’s time for Japow powder skiing at Rusutsu Resort, with views of Mount Yotei.

Beyond the cities, Hokkaido reveals its dramatic nature at Lake Toya, Showa Shinzan, and Mount Usu, followed by the hot spring town of Noboribetsu, home to Jigokudani (Hell Valley), the Bear Park, and Marine Park Nixe.

We also visit Shiraoi
title: Hokkaido — Japan’s Snowiest Island
